connector.name: MCP by ShieldZCash
connector.registryDescription: Keyless non-custodial crypto payments for AI agents: payment links and tip jars, no API key.
connector.summary: Hosted at shieldz.cash over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shieldzcash account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SHIELDZ_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Set a sk_live_/sk_test_ key to additionally enable full invoice management tools. Omit for keyless mode.
